subject: general
question: Select the synonym of Feeble.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Weak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Feeble"** means lacking physical strength, especially as a result of age or illness; it can also refer to something that is weak or ineffective. (कमजोर)

 
 
• **Example:** The old man’s voice was feeble and barely audible.
 
 
 
• **"Weak"** refers to something lacking strength or energy, similar to the meaning of "Feeble." (कमजोर)
 
 
• **Example:** After the long hike, she felt weak and needed to rest.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can conclude that the synonym of **'Feeble'** is **'Weak'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Weak**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Robust** (मजबूत): Strong and healthy; vigorous.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a robust immune system that rarely gets sick.
 
 
 
• **Strong** (ताकतवर): Having great physical power or strength.
 
 
• **Example:** He was strong enough to lift the heavy box by himself.
 
 
 
• **Sturdy** (मज़बूत): Firmly built or made; capable of withstanding pressure or weight.
 
 
• **Example:** The sturdy table did not wobble even under heavy weight.
